# RozgarJobs
> Free job board for Pakistan. Government, private and remote vacancies, updated every hour,
> with the closing date, salary, qualification and age limit on every listing.

Site: https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/
Language: English (en-PK)
Jobs live now: 120

## Main pages
- [All jobs](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/): search and filter every live vacancy
- [Government jobs](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/): filter the Government toggle
- [Job alerts](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/alerts.html): email and RSS alerts
- [Post a job](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/employers.html): employer listings
- [All locations](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/locations.html): every city and category page
- [Guides](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/guides/index.html): NJP, BPS scales, documents, scams
- [About](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/about.html) · [Contact](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/contact.html) · [Privacy](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/privacy.html) · [Terms](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/terms.html)

## Notes
- Every job page links to the original advertisement; Rozgar is an index, not the employer.
- We never charge candidates. Report a listing that asks for money.
- Machine-readable feeds: [jobs.json](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/data/jobs.json) · [RSS](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/feed.xml) · [sitemap](https://sarmads050.github.io/rozgar/sitemap.xml)
